SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Mining Arm Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: A form developed by the Gray through reverse-engineering the Empire's drill arm and improving it to suit their own characteristics. Unlike the Empire's version, it does not sacrifice normal manipulation ability.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.label: Farming Hand Form
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRUpgradeDef.description: A form developed by the Gray through reverse-engineering the Empire's field hand and improving it to suit their own characteristics. Unlike the Empire's version, it does not sacrifice normal manipulation ability.
